summary: @lsanger Best part We do not need new standards. #IndieWeb tech as https://aaronparecki.com pointed out uses a ton of w3c standards to connect everyone on the social network we call the web. body_html: @lsanger Best part We do not need new standards. #IndieWeb tech as https://aaronparecki.com pointed out uses a ton of w3c standards to connect everyone on the social network we call the web.
